newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers hold in quiet pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers hold in quiet pre-holiday trade.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotations were unchanged on Tuesday as most bunker traders closed midday, traders said.
"There are hardly no enquiries," a trader with a major oil company in the morning. "I shouldn't expect any change in prices as I don't expect anyone will do anything today."
Most traders did not have any bunker supplies to offer until next week amid low inventories in Singapore.
Bunker 380 cst at $126-$127 and 180 cst at $133-$134.00. MDO and gas oil were steady at $231-$245, $255-$262 respectively.
